verdicts.reason: A: the 'Spa Utopia' title sits on top of the green dropper and amber bottles. The subtitle has moved far from the title to the right and lands on the busy leaves. The beige brush-stroke panel is now an empty, stretched shape that no longer sits behind the text, so the brand lockup is broken. B makes all of this worse: the title is so large it covers both bottles and crowds the glass dish, the oversized subtitle fights the title for attention and also sits on the leaves, and the empty brush stroke overlaps the cream jar. The result is a jumbled, collision-heavy layout.
